headlines.headline: USTR Announces 60-Country Section 301 Forced-Labor Probe to Replace IEEPA — 10% and 12.5% Tracks
headlines.driver: For XLI: Positive blueprint — 10% vs 12.5% tracks drive country-level dispersion that XLI can arbitrage via sourcing (Central America/Jordan FTA, TRQs for US cotton).

headlines.headline: Canada Threatens Dollar-for-Dollar Retaliation if 50% Section 338 Hits — USMCA Talks Stall
headlines.driver: For XLI: Negative — retaliation threat is bilateral escalation driver that raises XLI's cross-border cost and USMCA withdrawal volatility, hedging XLI's near-term pricing gains.
